dialogue.speaker: A

communication_goal: 为等待过程提供状态反馈，不制造虚假的完成承诺。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer sits at the left of a small desk and gestures toward a large desktop monitor at center. The monitor's blank black inner screen contains exactly one large circular loading spinner made from a broken white ring with a clear gap; no arrows, text, percentages or other controls. Keep the spinner complete and unobstructed. The floating white OpenAI knot is at the right.
